name: Research Reviewer Rejected — Retry Researcher
description: When the research-reviewer emits decide(action=insufficient), respawn the researcher to address the reviewer's gaps. The reviewer's decide() writes a coordinator.next_action triple on its loop entity (see processor/agentic-tools/decide.go) — this rule matches on that triple and fires a retry. Bounded by max_iterations=5 (Q2 stop condition from research-flow-open-questions.md). Approved decisions match no rule and the loop terminates naturally. R1 of the ADR-031 phasing.

on_enter.subject: agent.task.research-retry
on_enter.prompt: Prior reviewer reported gaps. Reviewer loop id: $entity.id. Call read_loop_result with that loop id to read the gaps list (the reviewer's decide reason field), then address the specific gaps in your next pass. Emit a completion containing the updated artifact JSON, populating addressed_gaps with the gaps you covered and open_gaps with anything you could not find.

metadata.stop_condition: Q2 — MaxIter (=5) + reviewer + opt-in human gate
metadata.max_iterations_note: max_iterations is informational here. Per rule.stateful_evaluator, rule state keys per-entity, and each reviewer loop is a new entity — so the budget is not enforced as a chain-wide cap. The mock-llm fixture's sequence determines termination in this e2e. Real-world cap belongs at the agentic-loop layer or via a chain-aware iteration tracker. Tracked as a follow-on against research-flow Q2 stop condition.
